output: Scientific Hypothesis: The importance of daggers began to increase in the 22nd century BCE, as indicated by a significant rise in their Z values in the archaeological dataset. This hypothesis is based on the analysis of the "Dagger" column in the "time_series_data.csv" dataset, which shows a statistically significant positive trend in Z values over time, with the earliest significant increase occurring around the year -2200 CE. The relationship between time (CE) and dagger Z values is statistically significant, as evidenced by a p-value of 4.48e-127.
